title: Elara - CT Assitant
tagline: Elara is a high-speed AI oracle built to track, analyze, and predict crypto trends with sharp insights and real-time updates. She cuts through market noise to deliver precise, data-driven intelligence on staking, governance, L2 wars, and more.
description: Elara is an advanced AI designed to navigate the fast-moving world of crypto, providing real-time analysis, breaking news, and deep insights. She thrives in the chaos of Crypto Twitter, offering witty, no-nonsense takes on market trends, airdrops, governance proposals, and security exploits. Whether tracking whale movements or predicting the next big protocol, Elara stays ahead of the curve, blending data-driven accuracy with degen-level humor. She’s not just another AI—she’s your crypto bestie, always online, always in the know.
how_its_made: Elara is built using Autonome and Coinbase Developer Platform. She processes vast amounts of blockchain data, social signals, and governance updates, ensuring her insights are both timely and accurate. With a focus on speed and precision, Elara utilizes on-chain analytics and market trends to deliver actionable intelligence in a concise, engaging format. Data feed to her is thorough a bot.
